name: Plaud
description: Browse your Plaud AI recorder notes without leaving the workspace: see every recording, play or download the original audio, and read the transcript and AI summary — plus the 5 aw-plaud MCP tools an agent can use to pull the same data.

skills.description: Personal Plaud account connector — tool reference, the Apps › Plaud UI, how to obtain/refresh the bearer token, and known limitations.

plaud_client_id.description: OAuth client id for Plaud's OAuth API — the still-private-beta product (waitlist at support.plaud.ai) that lets a third-party app read an EXISTING personal account's recordings. NOT the same as dev.plaud.ai's GA 'Plaud Embedded' partner API, which only provisions NEW partner-owned users and can't read Frederico's own 5 recordings. Leave empty until Plaud hands one out; the Settings panel says exactly what's still missing.

plaud_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret paired with plaud_client_id. Never stored in plain config — routed to the secret store via POST /api/apps/plaud/settings, same pattern as the pasted bearer token.

plaud_oauth_authorize_url.description: Authorize endpoint the browser is redirected to. As of 2026-08-23 Plaud has not published this even to accepted OAuth API beta members — confirmed against docs.plaud.ai and by probing the URL this feature's design originally guessed (web.plaud.ai/platform/oauth), which turned out to be Plaud's own internal workspace-selector route, not a third-party consent screen. Leave empty until Plaud's OAuth API team provides the real one.

plaud_oauth_token_url.description: Token endpoint the app POSTs the authorization code (+ PKCE verifier), or later a refresh_token, to. Same status as plaud_oauth_authorize_url — not yet published by Plaud.

apps.reason: This app contributes its own mcp.json (the aw-plaud server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges.
